items.exampleEn: She wore a sparkling silver dress to the party.
items.exampleZh: 她穿了一件閃閃發亮的銀色洋裝去參加派對。
items.glossZh: 閃閃發亮的；（飲料）有氣泡的

items.exampleEn: The old bridge is unsafe for heavy trucks.
items.exampleZh: 那座舊橋讓重型卡車通行並不安全。

items.exampleEn: The landlord's demand for more rent was unreasonable.
items.exampleZh: 房東要求漲房租是不合理的。

items.exampleEn: The unofficial results show that the blue team won.
items.exampleZh: 非官方的結果顯示藍隊獲勝。

items.exampleEn: The dancer moved across the stage with great elegance.
items.exampleZh: 那位舞者在舞台上優雅地移動。

items.exampleEn: Let's avoid needless arguments and focus on the work.
items.exampleZh: 我們避免不必要的爭吵，專心工作吧。

items.exampleEn: The new assistant should preferably speak English and Spanish.
items.exampleZh: 新助理最好會說英語和西班牙語。

items.exampleEn: The sea air tasted salty on my lips.
items.exampleZh: 海風吹在嘴唇上感覺鹹鹹的。

items.sentenceEn: Please send the form by Friday, preferably by email.
items.sentenceZh: 請在星期五前寄出表格，最好用電子郵件。

items.audioEn: The cheese was so salty that I drank three glasses of water afterward.
items.audioZh: 那塊起司鹹到我事後喝了三杯水。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼喝了很多水？
options: It was a very hot day

items.sentenceEn: The lake was sparkling in the morning sun.
items.sentenceZh: 湖面在晨光中閃閃發亮。

items.sentenceEn: It's unsafe to swim here when the waves are high.
items.sentenceZh: 浪大的時候在這裡游泳很不安全。

items.stemEn: Asking workers to stay until midnight every day is ____.
items.stemZh: 要求員工每天待到半夜是不合理的。

items.stemEn: These are only ____ numbers; the final report comes out next week.
items.stemZh: 這些只是非官方的數字，最終報告下週才會出爐。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, my friends and I tried a new restaurant near the harbor. The main room was decorated with real elegance, with sparkling lights hanging from the ceiling, and the staff showed great hospitality. The menu said customers should book, preferably two days ahead. The food was mostly good, although the fish soup was a bit salty. The only problem was the prices, which seemed unreasonable for such small dishes. Needless to say, we will not go back very often.
items.passageZh: 上週六，我和朋友去試了港口附近一家新餐廳。主用餐區裝潢得非常優雅，天花板上掛著閃閃發亮的燈，店員也非常熱情好客。菜單上寫著客人最好提前兩天訂位。食物大致不錯，只是魚湯有點鹹。唯一的問題是價格，那麼小份的菜，價錢似乎不太合理。不用說，我們不會常去。

questions.questionZh: 作者對這家餐廳最不滿意的是什麼？
菜單上建議客人怎麼做？

items.promptZh: 那棟老建築因為不安全而被關閉了。
referenceEn: The old building was closed because it was unsafe.
Because it was unsafe, the old building was closed.
rubricZh: 要用 unsafe 當形容詞（例如 it was unsafe）
「被關閉」可寫，例如 was closed、has been closed，或主動句 they closed… 等
原因可放句首或句尾，例如 because it was unsafe 等

items.promptZh: 這支手錶設計簡單，帶有一種低調的優雅。
referenceEn: This watch has a simple design and a quiet elegance.
The simple design of this watch gives it a quiet elegance.
rubricZh: elegance 表示「優雅」（例如 a quiet elegance、simple elegance 等）
「低調的」可寫，例如 quiet、simple、understated 等
